name: Instagram (Instagram Login)
description: Instagram API with Instagram Login for professional (Business/Creator) accounts: media publishing, comments, insights, stories, tags, messaging, and webhook field enablement.

fields.label: Instagram User access token
fields.description: Existing token from the matching Meta login product. Automatic token refresh is not implemented.

fields.label: Instagram professional account ID
fields.description: Bind this connection to the Instagram account represented by the token; this is not a Facebook Page ID.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Read the bound professional Instagram account identity using the stored access token. A provider identity is required for monitoring evidence.

users.get.title: Get Account
users.get.description: Read the identity of the professional account bound to this connection.

media.list.title: List Media
media.list.description: List one page of media owned by the bound account. Pass after to request a subsequent page; cursor presence alone does not guarantee another page.

after.description: Opaque after cursor from a prior response.

media.get.title: Get Media
media.get.description: Read a published media object visible to this connection. Media CDN URLs can expire.

containers.createImage.title: Create Image Container
containers.createImage.description: Create an unpublished image container from a public JPEG URL. This does not publish. Check container status and explicitly publish when ready.

imageUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

containers.createReel.title: Create Reel Container
containers.createReel.description: Create an unpublished Reel container from a public video URL. Processing is asynchronous; poll containers.get separately, then explicitly publish when FINISHED.

videoUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

caption.description: Caption text, subject to provider content limits.

shareToFeed.description: Whether the Reel also appears in the feed.

coverUrl.description: Publicly accessible media URL; Meta retrieves the file.

thumbOffset.description: Cover frame offset in milliseconds; coverUrl takes precedence.

containers.get.title: Get Container Status
containers.get.description: Check an unpublished container. FINISHED means ready to publish; IN_PROGRESS means processing; ERROR, EXPIRED and PUBLISHED are terminal states. No automatic polling occurs.

media.publish.title: Publish Media Container
media.publish.description: Publish a previously created container to the bound account. Call containers.get first and publish only when FINISHED. A returned ID identifies the published media; this operation does not retry or poll.

creationId.description: Container ID ready for publication, not a published media ID.

publishing.limit.title: Get Publishing Usage
publishing.limit.description: Read current publishing usage and provider quota configuration. Quotas may differ by account and API behavior; no fixed cap is assumed.

create_carousel_container.title: Create Carousel Container
create_carousel_container.description: Create an unpublished CAROUSEL container from 2-10 child creation IDs. Create each child first with post_ig_user_media (is_carousel_item=true) and wait until FINISHED. Containers expire in under 24 hours.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

children.description: Comma-separated child container IDs. Order is the slide order. Total 2-10 items.

location_id.description: Facebook Page ID of a location to tag.

share_to_feed.description: Whether the carousel also appears in the main feed.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

create_media_container.title: Create Media Container (Deprecated)
create_media_container.description: DEPRECATED: prefer post_ig_user_media. Create an unpublished image, Reel, story, or carousel-child container from a public URL. Does not publish. Poll get_post_status until FINISHED before create_post. Containers expire in ~24 hours.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text for a single image (max 1,000 characters).

children.description: Comma-separated child container IDs for a CAROUSEL parent (2-10).

cover_url.description: Public HTTPS cover image URL for a Reel or video.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS JPEG/PNG URL that Meta can fetch.

user_tags.description: Public Instagram accounts to tag. Images require username, x, and y (0.0-1.0); Reels allow username only.

x.description: Horizontal tag position from the top-left (0.0-1.0).

y.description: Vertical tag position from the top-left (0.0-1.0).

video_url.description: Public HTTPS MP4/MOV URL that Meta can fetch.

media_type.description: Graph media_type: REELS, CAROUSEL, or STORIES. Omit for a feed image.

location_id.description: Facebook Page ID of a location that has latitude/longitude.

thumb_offset.description: Cover frame offset in milliseconds for videos/Reels.

share_to_feed.description: For Reels, also show the item in the main feed.

is_carousel_item.description: Mark this container as a carousel child. Create 2-10 children, then a CAROUSEL parent.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

create_post.title: Create Post (Deprecated)
create_post.description: DEPRECATED: prefer post_ig_user_media_publish. Publish a FINISHED container. This call does not poll; publishing a container that is still IN_PROGRESS returns Graph error 9007.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

creation_id.description: Container ID from create_media_container or create_carousel_container (the JSON id field).

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

delete_comment.title: Delete Comment
delete_comment.description: Delete a comment created by the bound professional account, or a comment on media the account owns.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

delete_messenger_profile.title: Delete Messenger Profile
delete_messenger_profile.description: Remove ice breakers and/or the persistent menu from the Instagram messenger profile.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

fields.description: Profile fields to delete: ice_breakers, persistent_menu.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

enable_webhook_subscriptions.title: Enable Webhook Subscriptions
enable_webhook_subscriptions.description: Enable Instagram Login webhook fields on the bound professional account. This does not set the app callback URL. The Meta app must be Live with a configured callback.

subscribed_fields.description: Webhook fields to enable: comments, live_comments, message_echoes, message_reactions, messages, messaging_handover, messaging_optins, messaging_postbacks, messaging_referral, messaging_seen, standby.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_conversation.title: Get Conversation
get_conversation.description: Read one Instagram DM thread (participants and metadata). The thread must already exist; the API cannot start first-contact DMs.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID from list_all_conversations (often a base64 IGSID thread).

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_ig_comment_replies.title: Get IG Comment Replies
get_ig_comment_replies.description: List replies to a parent Instagram comment.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_ig_media.title: Get Instagram Media
get_ig_media.description: Read a published Instagram media object (photo, video, story, reel, or carousel). Unpublished container IDs should use get_post_status instead.

ig_media_id.description: Numeric Graph media ID, not an instagram.com shortcode.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_ig_media_children.title: Get IG Media Children
get_ig_media_children.description: List child media objects of a CAROUSEL_ALBUM post. Insights are queried on the parent, not the children.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

get_ig_media_comments.title: List Media Comments
get_ig_media_comments.description: List one page of comments on a published media object owned by the bound account.

ig_media_id.description: Published media ID (not a user ID).

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_ig_media_insights.title: Get IG Media Insights
get_ig_media_insights.description: Read lifetime insights for published media. Requires a Business/Creator account, typically 1,000+ followers, and media younger than two years. Do not request deprecated metrics such as impressions, plays, or engagement.

metric.description: Metrics such as views, reach, saved, likes, comments, shares, total_interactions, reposts. Reels also support ig_reels_video_view_total_time, ig_reels_avg_watch_time, reels_skip_rate.

period.description: Unused for media insights; Graph uses lifetime.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_ig_user_content_publishing_limit.title: Get IG User Content Publishing Limit
get_ig_user_content_publishing_limit.description: Read the bound account's content publishing quota usage for the current 24-hour window.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

since.description: Unix timestamp start of the 24-hour window; must be within the last 24 hours.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

get_ig_user_live_media.description: Read live media for an in-progress broadcast on the bound professional account.

get_ig_user_media.description: List one cursor page of media owned by the bound professional account. Use after for the next page; cursor presence alone does not guarantee another page.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

since.description: Unix timestamp; media created after this time.

until.description: Unix timestamp; media created before this time.

auto_resolve_fb_page_id.description: Deprecated no-op retained for Composio compatibility.

get_ig_user_stories.description: List currently active 24-hour story media for the bound professional account.

get_multiple_nodes.title: Get Multiple Graph Nodes
get_multiple_nodes.description: Retrieve the same selected fields for multiple Instagram Graph nodes on graph.instagram.com, preserving the provider's ID-to-object mapping. Pass up to 50 comma-separated object IDs.

object_ids.description: Instagram Graph node IDs to retrieve, up to 50 per call. A comma-separated string is sent as the ids query.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated field projection valid for every requested node.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_page_conversations.title: Get Page Conversations
get_page_conversations.description: List Instagram DM conversations for the bound professional account (platform=instagram).

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

platform.description: Conversation platform filter. Sent as instagram.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

get_post_comments.description: DEPRECATED: prefer get_ig_media_comments. List comments on a published post.

get_post_status.description: DEPRECATED: check an unpublished container. FINISHED means ready to publish; IN_PROGRESS means processing; ERROR, EXPIRED, and PUBLISHED are terminal. This operation does not poll.

get_user_info.title: Get User Info
get_user_info.description: Read the bound professional Instagram account. followers_count and follows_count are returned for the authenticated profile.

get_user_insights.description: Read account-level insights. All metrics in one call must share a period. Demographics metrics require timeframe and period=lifetime. Do not request impressions or audience_* metrics.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

metric.description: Metrics such as reach, views, accounts_engaged, total_interactions, follower_count, profile_views.

since.description: Range start as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

until.description: Range end as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

breakdown.description: Breakdown when metric_type=total_value: contact_button_type, follow_type, media_product_type, age, city, country, gender.

timeframe.description: Required for demographics metrics: this_week or this_month.

post_ig_comment_replies.title: Post IG Comment Replies
post_ig_comment_replies.description: Reply to a comment on media owned by the bound professional account. Replies must be 300 characters or fewer, with at most 4 hashtags and 1 URL, and cannot be entirely uppercase.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

post_ig_media_comments.title: Post IG Media Comments

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

post_ig_user_media.title: Post IG User Media
post_ig_user_media.description: Create an unpublished media container (image, Reel, story, carousel child, or carousel parent). This is step one of two-step publishing; call post_ig_user_media_publish with the returned id after status is FINISHED. Provide image_url, video_url, or children. Local file uploads are not sent; use a public HTTPS URL.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

alt_text.description: Accessibility alt text for a single image (max 1,000 characters).

children.description: Comma-separated child container IDs for a CAROUSEL parent (2-10).

cover_url.description: Public HTTPS cover image URL for a Reel or video.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS JPEG/PNG URL that Meta can fetch.

user_tags.description: Public Instagram accounts to tag. Images require username, x, and y (0.0-1.0); Reels allow username only.

x.description: Horizontal tag position from the top-left (0.0-1.0).

y.description: Vertical tag position from the top-left (0.0-1.0).

video_url.description: Public HTTPS MP4/MOV URL that Meta can fetch.

media_type.description: Graph media_type: REELS, CAROUSEL, or STORIES. Omit for a feed image.

location_id.description: Facebook Page ID of a location that has latitude/longitude.

thumb_offset.description: Cover frame offset in milliseconds for videos/Reels.

share_to_feed.description: For Reels, also show the item in the main feed.

is_carousel_item.description: Mark this container as a carousel child. Create 2-10 children, then a CAROUSEL parent.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

post_ig_user_media_publish.title: Publish IG User Media
post_ig_user_media_publish.description: Publish a FINISHED container. This call does not wait or retry; poll get_post_status until FINISHED (avoid Graph error 9007). Read get_ig_user_content_publishing_limit before bulk publishing.

ig_user_id.description: Instagram Business or Creator account ID. Optional; the bound professional account ID is used on the wire.

max_wait_seconds.description: Ignored; this connector does not poll. Wait for FINISHED before calling.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Ignored; this connector does not poll.

graph_api_version.description: Ignored Graph API version hint; this connector calls graph.instagram.com/v26.0.

id.description: Instagram object ID when the provider returns one.

post_ig_user_mentions.description: Reply to a mention of the bound professional account by commenting on the mentioning media or comment.

media_id.description: Media ID that contains the mention.

message.description: Reply text posted as a comment.

comment_id.description: Optional comment ID to reply to; omit to comment on the media.

send_image.title: Send Image
send_image.description: Send an image DM to an Instagram-scoped user in an existing conversation. The image URL must be a public HTTPS file. Cannot start a new thread.

send_text_message.title: Send Text Message

recipient_id.description: Recipient IGSID from conversations or webhooks, not a username.

reply_to.description: Optional reply target. Set mid to the message id being replied to (Composio reply_to_message_id).

mid.description: Message mid from a webhook or list_all_messages.

reply_to_message_id.description: Composio alias for reply_to.mid. Pass reply_to: { mid } on the wire.
